newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ivory & Sime recruits new small-cap team.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ivory & Sime recruits new small-cap team.

text.p: Edinburgh-based fund manager Ivory & Sime Plc said on Wednesday it had recruited a new UK small cap team from Scottish Amicable Investment Managers to fill vacancies created by the departure of the existing team.
The team comprises John Johnston, Stephen Grant and Glen Nimmo, Ivory & Sime said.

"The appointment of a well-respected UK smaller companies team is good news for the company," chairman Sir James McKinnon said in a statement. "The board looks forward to the marked outperformance of the last 12 months continuing."
Several senior fund managers resigned from Ivory & Sime in recent months, followed by managing director Colin Hook who resigned at the start of February.
The company has since announced a number of new appointments to fill the gaps caused by the resignations.
